orensic Sciences University (formerly Gujarat Forensic
Sciences. UnivUniversity) was established in 2009 by the
Government of Gujarat under the leadership of Shri Narendra
Modi, then Chief Minister of Gujarat, with the objective of creating
professional experts in forensic sciences to address the growing
complexity of crime involving advanced technologies. As a first￾of-its-kind institution dedicated exclusively to forensic sciences,
the university rapidly expanded from four courses in three
institutes to around forty specialised programs, including forensic
nursing, forensic odontology, homeland security, anti-terrorism,
and digital forensics. Recognised for its academic excellence,
research contributions, and professional training initiatives, it was
accorded the status of an Institution of National Importance and
a Central University in October, 2020. With UGC recognition, NAAC
accreditation, centres of excellence, and national and
international collaborations, NFSU serves as a premier hub for
education, research, training, and consultancy in forensic and
criminal investigation sciences.

About
SCHOOL OF LAW, FORENSIC
JUSTICE, AND POLICY STUDIES
he School of Law, Forensic Justice, and Policy Studies is
dedicated to transtransforming legal education by integrating
forensic science with law and policymaking. With a strong focus
on technology-driven legal studies, the school prepares legal
professionals, policymakers, and justice administrators to handle
the complexities of today’s evolving legal landscape. Its cutting￾edge programs blend forensic science with law, ensuring that
graduates are not only proficient in legal principles but also
equipped with the skills to tackle modern challenges in an
increasingly digital world. Beyond academics, the school plays a
crucial role in crime prevention, reduction, and mapping, working
towards a legal system that ensures swift and fair justice. It
aspires to shape techno-legal experts who can contribute to
governance, enhance efficiency, and uphold the rule of law and
justice. Through an interdisciplinary approach, the school is
committed to building a stronger, more just society where law
and forensic science come together to create meaningful
change.

bout Legal Startups
Indian Legal System is going through a tough time because of the
pendency of cases for years. Many efforts have been made to cope
up with this situation. We need a radical change in the legal system
and innovation is the answer to this. Western countries have come
up with severalinnovative platforms i.e. legal startups to address
various legal affairs. We also need legal startups in India to make
the system efficient and effective which is non-existent. People do
not know about legal startups.
Looking at this situation, Legal Startups has been created for
highlighting all legal startups across the world. The main objective of
Legal Startups is to highlight all legal startups and put it on one
platform.

A
bout HACKATHON
he legal field is witnessing rapid changes with the emergence of
technology, changing methods of legal service delivery and
increasing demands for efficient and accessible legal solutions.
These developments create a need for innovative approaches to
address contemporary challenges in the legal ecosystem. With the
objective of encouraging innovation and entrepreneurial thinking in
the field of law, the School of Law, Forensic Justice, & Policy Studies,
National Forensic Sciences University, Delhi Campus, is organising
the National Legal Hackathon, 2026.
The competition aims to provide a platform for students and young
innovators to identify existing problems in the legal ecosystem and
present their ideas, initiatives or existing startups developed to
address such problems. The competition encourages participants to
think beyond conventional methods and develop solutions having
practical application and potential for wider implementation.
The competition will provide an opportunity to present innovative
ideas before a panel of experts and receive recognition for solutions
demonstrating originality, relevance and practical potential.

Guidelines
The competition is open to students/PHD scholars of universities
and colleges across India.
Participation shall be allowed only in teams. Each team shall
consist of a minimum of two (2) and a maximum of four (4)
members.
A participant shall be a member of only one team.
Teams may comprise participants from the same or different
institutions.
A complimentary workshop on “Legal Startups” shall be
conducted on 16th October 2026. Teams may attend the
workshop to gain insights into legal innovation and startup
development. Participation in the workshop is optional.
The proposed startup/innovation or existing startup/initiative
must pertain to the legal field and should address a problem,
need, gap or challenge arising within the legal ecosystem,
including those faced by lawyers, law firms, law students, legal
professionals, clients, legal institutions or other stakeholders in
the delivery, practice, study or administration of law.
Each team shall be permitted to present one startup/innovation
idea or initiative only.
The competition shall be conducted in three stages. Teams
shall first submit their proposal through the prescribed online
submission process.
Based on the submissions received, 20 teams shall be
shortlisted for the In-Campus Round.

--- Page Break ---

After the shortlisting, there will be 2 further rounds in the
competition, preliminary and final. The preliminary round will
be conducted on Friday, October 16, 2026, and the Final on
Saturday, October 17, 2026. The top 5 teams will proceed to the
final round. The Finals shall be adjudged on the basis of
research undertaken, steps of implementation, methods
adopted for improvisation, application success, Novelty as
parameters, and presentation. The teams will be adjudged
according to these parameters.
Business Plan/Proposal to be sent in the prescribed format
below shall be submitted through google form
(https://forms.gle/7j3GETy77NfW4NKz6) in the pdf file only on or
before Saturday, September 26, 2026, by 11.59 p.m. Business
Plan will consist of the following:
I.Coverpage mentioning name of all members, affiliation,
mobile no, email id,
II.Table of Content
III.Executive Summary
IV.Details as per headings mentioned in Annexure
Teams shall be evaluated on parameters including originality of
the idea, identification of the problem, relevance of the
proposed solution, feasibility, potential impact and
presentation.
Participants shall ensure that the idea or proposal submitted by
them is their original work. Any instance of plagiarism or
misrepresentation may lead to disqualification.
The decision of the Judging Panel/Organising Committee shall
be final and binding in matters relating to the competition.
The organisers reserve the right to make necessary changes to
the schedule, format or other arrangements of the competition,
if required.
